name: @bernouy/envelope-crypto
description: Envelope-encryption substrate — per-scope DEKs wrapped by a process-level KEK (`EnvelopeSecretCrypto`, `KekProvider`/`LocalKekProvider`, `DekRepository`, AES-GCM helpers). One platform-wide instance serves every encrypted-at-rest consumer (secret store, PII). The Mongo-backed DEK repository lives under the `./mongo` subpath; the root export stays dependency-free.
